notes.title: Patch 0.7.13
notes.notes:
A new patch update is here, this time we fixed an annoying bug where the player would sometimes die crushed after exiting the slide.

We also fixed another bug where the player could win the level and die within 0.1 seconds and it would count as both a death and a level win.

notes.title: The Speedrun Mode Update and the Speedrun Tournament!
notes.notes:
We now have a mode that allows you to play the whole game in a single go, no cutscenes, no extra animations, allows you to reset the whole run from the start and also shows a ingame timer and show all of your runs history to see your progress!

To celebrate that we are having a speedrun tournament! Join by clicking the image!

[url=https://discord.gg/btyPMgR][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215722/e383cdd4cb8480b72e56b3b5802896a232e4bdaa.png[/img][/url]

The rules:
- The run needs to be on the current patch for the day of the beginning of the competition.
- The run needs to be on the speed run mode.
- The time for the run will be time shown on the end run screen.
- Any % runs.
- The run needs to be recorded in an uncut video.
- The video record of the run should be sent to the appropriate discord channel by May 11th 12pm GMT.
- If there are any major game breaking bugs and exploits, they might be judged invalid, if that happens we will update the rules here saying that runs using that exploit will not be valid.
- We might invalidate runs for others reasons that we didn't predict on this rule set if we judge it's a good reason to.

The prizes:

 1st place :

The person will have it's name and portrait displayed in a in-game hall of fame (we will show an example this week).

Special thanks on the game credits as outstanding community member.

Custom discord role: Fastest Matt of the Multiverse.

2-10th place:

Custom discord role as Really Fast Matt.

Special thanks on the game credits as outstanding community member.
